meta.title: Annual local-currency price index, PPP conversion factor and PPP-corrected gold-denominated index, 10 emerging economies + US reference

price_index.BR: FGV IGP-DI chained from monthly % changes (BCB SGS s.190, 1944+): general price index with ~60% wholesale weights (WPI proxy)
price_index.default: consumer price index, World Bank FP.CPI.TOTL (2010=100). Official WPI/PPI portals (India OEA/RBI, Mexico INEGI/Banxico, China NBS, etc.) are not reachable headlessly; swap-in possible via the pi series

meta.ppp_method: World Bank PA.NUS.PPP (LCU per international dollar) from 1990; pre-1990 backcast: ppp(t) = ppp(1990) * [pi(t)/pi(1990)] / [CPI_US(t)/CPI_US(1990)] (constant 1990 real exchange rate; US CPI from FRED CPIAUCSL). No official PPP exists before 1990.
meta.gold: annual average USD/oz, 1950-2025, from monthly market prices (gold_monthly.csv; London fixing / COMEX; cached from the commodity project)
meta.us_reference: United States: WPI in gold terms from data/wpi_annual_1800_2026.json (rebased to 2010=100 in wpi_em_sync.py)
